strategies.text: Charges at the first player in line; tank at the door and kill his adds as they spill in.
He enrages and hits very hard; save defensive cooldowns until after the first pull.
Pull the guards away first; he has a cannon shot that hits the group, so stand on a spot where it hits few.
Mind-controls and fears; the group should stay together so one player can be freed fast.

notes: Forever splits Stratholme into Live and Undead for the Group Finder; this file is the live (Main Gate) side. Floor 2 uiMapID 318 is verified by AllTheThings (maps={318} on Stratholme). Route is typical. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
